2609.35564.title: Almieyar: A Culturally Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition
2609.35564.paper_summary: Arabic speech technology has largely focused on Modern Standard Arabic, leaving the living dialects spoken by hundreds of millions under-served. We introduce ALMIEYAR, a culturally grounded ASR benchmark covering 17 Arabic dialects across six families, built entirely from newly recorded speech unseen by existing models. Dialect-community coordinators selected culturally relevant images across 10 topics, and native speakers described them through five structured scenarios, yielding approximately 50 minutes per dialect (13.7 hours total). We benchmark 12 state-of-the-art ASR systems zero-shot, including GPT-4o-transcribe, Voxtral-Mini-4B, Fanar-STT-LF, Whisper, SeamlessM4T-v2, and wav2vec2-based models. GPT-4o-transcribe achieves the lowest overall WER at 35.0%, followed by Voxtral-Mini-4B, Fanar-STT-LF, and Whisper-Large-v3 at 41.1%, 45.9%, and 49.5%, respectively, indicating substantial remaining errors across Arabic dialect communities. Performance varies considerably across dialect groups, with no model performing uniformly best across all groups. WER alone also obscures dialectal ASR behaviour: wav2vec2-based models show large WER/CER gaps, where character-level agreement remains much higher than word-level accuracy, motivating joint WER/CER reporting. ALMIEYAR provides a unified benchmark for culturally grounded Arabic ASR evaluation, including the first published benchmark for Ahwazi Arabic.
2609.35564.paper_summary_zh: 阿拉伯語言技術主要集中在現代標準阿拉伯語上，讓數以億計的生活方言未受到充分服務。我們介紹了ALMIEYAR，一個以文化為基礎的自動語音識別基準，涵蓋六個語言家族中的17種阿拉伯方言，完全由新錄製的語音構建，這些語音在現有模型中未曾見過。方言社區協調員在10個主題中選擇了文化相關的圖像，並由母語者通過五個結構化場景進行描述，每種方言產生約50分鐘的錄音（總計13.7小時）。我們對12個最先進的自動語音識別系統進行零樣本基準測試，包括GPT-4o-transcribe、Voxtral-Mini-4B、Fanar-STT-LF、Whisper、SeamlessM4T-v2和基於wav2vec2的模型。GPT-4o-transcribe在整體字錯誤率（WER）上達到最低值35.0%，其次是Voxtral-Mini-4B、Fanar-STT-LF和Whisper-Large-v3，分別為41.1%、45.9%和49.5%，這表明阿拉伯方言社區仍存在大量錯誤。不同方言群體的表現差異顯著，沒有任何模型在所有群體中表現均最佳。僅僅依賴WER也掩蓋了方言自動語音識別的行為：基於wav2vec2的模型顯示出較大的WER/CER差距，字符級別的一致性遠高於單詞級別的準確性，這促使了聯合WER/CER報告。ALMIEYAR提供了一個統一的基準，用於以文化為基礎的阿拉伯自動語音識別評估，包括首個發表的阿哈瓦茲阿拉伯語基準。
